Phase 78 plan: docs/phases/review-criteria-ai-output.md (roadmap entry added; branch phase-78-review-criteria-ai-output on main after PR #67).
Source: docs/tagteam-issue-review-criteria-ai-output-2026-11-15.md, a field proposal from the Aegis session. Arbiter's ruling 2026-11-16: split it. Tagteam takes only what is true of AI-written work in any project; one project's review policy does not ship in the contract or default lenses.
Proposal: two lines of lens text. correctness.md gains 'references that do not exist'; verification.md gains 'untested promised behaviour or a skipped/xfail test carries a stated reason'. Wording taken verbatim from the issue doc's patch.
Deliberately not done: no SKILL.md change (so no hash entry); the patch's dependency, secrets and plan-review items are out and stay in the proposing project (AGENTS.md, or a lens override, with the override-replaces-builtin and 3-lens limits noted in the plan).
Known consequence, stated in the plan: the new items reach only paneled reviews.
Checked: lens override path exists (_resolve_brief + test_resolve_builtin_override_config_and_missing); PANEL_MAX_LENSES is 3; no test pins the lens 'Look for' text (grep). Planning only, no code yet. Also on this branch: Phase 77 marked Complete (merged, PR #67).

Approved. Reviewed the plan and source proposal against the current correctness/verification briefs, _resolve_brief, prompt composition/preview, and the existing override/preview tests. The two prompt additions fit their lens responsibilities and honor the recorded arbiter split; the panel-only reach, replacement semantics of overrides, and lack of behavioral efficacy evidence are explicit. No engine or contract change is needed. Implementation note: interpret success criterion 2 as excluding dependency-policy and secrets checklist items, not banning the word dependency (the approved nonexistent-reference wording itself says installed dependency). Keep the tests focused on prompt delivery and retain the existing severity guidance. Plan review only; no tests run.
